from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from actstream.models import actor_stream
from .serializers import ActionActivitySerializer

User = get_user_model()

class UserActivityTimelineView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, target_user_id):
        target_user = get_object_or_404(User, pk=target_user_id)
        # Ensure caller is requesting their own stream or shares authorized organization administration
        if target_user != request.user and not (request.user.is_staff or request.user.has_perm('actstream.view_user_stream')):
            raise PermissionDenied("You do not have permission to view this user's activity stream")

        actions = actor_stream(target_user).filter(data__tenant_id=request.user.tenant_id)[:50]
        serializer = ActionActivitySerializer(actions, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
